issues_including_pull_requests.title: Refactor project into feature-based architecture
issues_including_pull_requests.body:
## Changes

- Restructured the project into a clean feature-based architecture
- Organized destinations, map, authentication, bookings, trip planner, intelligence, profile, admin, and home modules
- Separated common, layout, and reusable UI components
- Moved global React contexts into `src/contexts`
- Organized Supabase client under `src/services/supabase`
- Moved shared utilities into `src/utils`
- Updated all affected imports and paths
- Preserved existing business logic, UI, and Supabase integration
- Removed obsolete `src/routes` and `src/lib` structure

## Validation

- TypeScript check passed with `npm run lint`
- Production build passed with `npm run build`
- No database schema changes
- Supabase integration preserved
- No merge conflicts
